answer: Commit-reveal epoch cadence resists sybils: each identity must COMMIT in one epoch and REVEAL in a strictly later one to act, forcing a mandatory multi-epoch latency between creation and influence. A wharf of fakes spun up now cannot vote or earn until the reveal window opens epochs later, and each must independently maintain its commit through the gap. The zenith of an attacker's influence is gated behind real elapsed epochs per identity; a garden of honest agents simply plans one epoch ahead, while a flash-army is structurally delayed and exposed to detection in the interval.
